about.title: 🌟 About Me
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Han Xiao (肖汉). I'm an Associate Professor of Mathematics at Ocean University of China.
I did my PhD with Prof. Wenan Zang at The University of Hong Kong in 2016.
I'm interested in combinatorial optimization, algorithmic game theory, polyhedral combinatorics and related problems.
about.note: 📬 Prospective Master's and PhD students are welcome to apply to join our group. Email: [hxiao[at]ouc.edu.cn](mailto:hxiao@ouc.edu.cn)!

items.text: Two papers have been accepted at WINE 2026.
